```{=html}
<style>
  @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=EB+Garamond:ital,wght@0,400;0,700;0,800;1,400&display=swap');

  /* kill quarto chrome on this page */
  #quarto-content { padding: 0 !important; }
  .page-layout-full .content { max-width: 100% !important; padding: 0 !important; }
  #quarto-margin-sidebar, #TOC { display: none !important; }

  .booking-page {
    --bk-fg: #0a0a0a;
    --bk-bg: #f4f1eb;
    --bk-accent: #c23a22;
    --bk-muted: #8a8578;
    --bk-rule: #0a0a0a;
    --bk-embed-bg: #ffffff;
    font-family: 'Palatino Linotype', 'EB Garamond', 'Palatino', serif;
    background: var(--bk-bg);
    color: var(--bk-fg);
    min-height: 100vh;
  }

  .bk-header {
    padding: 6rem 2rem 3rem;
    max-width: 900px;
    margin: 0 auto;
  }

  .bk-overline {
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.35em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--bk-muted);
    margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
    font-weight: 500;
  }

  .bk-title {
    font-family: 'EB Garamond', 'Palatino Linotype', 'Palatino', serif;
    font-size: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 5.5rem);
    font-weight: 800;
    line-height: 0.95;
    margin: 0 0 1.5rem 0;
    letter-spacing: -0.03em;
    color: var(--bk-fg);
  }

  .bk-title .accent {
    color: var(--bk-accent);
  }

  .bk-rule {
    width: 100%;
    height: 3px;
    background: var(--bk-fg);
    border: none;
    margin: 0 0 2rem 0;
  }

  .bk-description {
    font-size: 1.15rem;
    line-height: 1.7;
    color: var(--bk-fg);
    max-width: 600px;
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
  }

  .bk-description a {
    color: var(--bk-accent);
    text-decoration: none;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--bk-accent);
  }

  .bk-meta {
    font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.15em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--bk-muted);
    margin-top: 2rem;
    display: flex;
    gap: 2.5rem;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }

  .bk-meta span::before {
    content: '■ ';
    color: var(--bk-accent);
    font-size: 0.6rem;
    vertical-align: middle;
  }

  /* embed container */
  .bk-embed-wrap {
    max-width: 1100px;
    margin: 2rem auto 0;
    padding: 0 2rem 4rem;
  }

  .bk-embed-frame {
    background: var(--bk-embed-bg);
    border: 2px solid var(--bk-fg);
    padding: 1.5rem;
    min-height: 500px;
    position: relative;
  }

  .bk-embed-frame::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: 6px;
    left: 6px;
    right: -6px;
    bottom: -6px;
    border: 1px solid var(--bk-muted);
    z-index: -1;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  #cal-embed {
    min-height: 480px;
    width: 100%;
  }

  /* footer */
  .bk-footer {
    max-width: 900px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 2rem 2rem 4rem;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--bk-muted);
    font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    color: var(--bk-muted);
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 1rem;
  }

  .bk-footer a {
    color: var(--bk-muted);
    text-decoration: none;
    border-bottom: 1px solid transparent;
    transition: border-color 0.2s;
  }

  .bk-footer a:hover {
    border-bottom-color: var(--bk-accent);
  }

  /* responsive */
  @media (max-width: 600px) {
    .bk-header { padding: 3rem 1.25rem 2rem; }
    .bk-embed-wrap { padding: 0 1.25rem 3rem; }
    .bk-embed-frame { padding: 0.75rem; }
    .bk-embed-frame::before { display: none; }
    .bk-meta { flex-direction: column; gap: 0.75rem; }
  }
</style>

<div class="booking-page">
  <div class="bk-header">
    <div class="bk-overline">Werner Hernani-Limarino</div>
    <h1 class="bk-title">Book <span class="accent">a slot.</span></h1>
    <hr class="bk-rule">
    <p class="bk-description">
      Consulting, research collaboration, or a conversation about Bolivia.
      Pick a time that works — the calendar reads my availability live.
    </p>
    <div class="bk-meta">
      <span>30 min default</span>
      <span>Video or in-person CDMX</span>
      <span>UTC−6 / America/Mexico_City</span>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="bk-embed-wrap">
    <div class="bk-embed-frame">
      <div id="cal-embed"></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="bk-footer">
    <span>Powered by <a href="https://cal.com" target="_blank">Cal.com</a> — open source scheduling</span>
    <span><a href="mailto:wernerhl@gmail.com">wernerhl@gmail.com</a></span>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- Cal.com embed loader -->
<script type="text/javascript">
(function (C, A, L) {
  let p = function (a, ar) { a.q.push(ar); };
  let d = C.document;
  C.Cal = C.Cal || function () {
    let cal = C.Cal; let ar = arguments;
    if (!cal.loaded) {
      cal.ns = {}; cal.q = cal.q || [];
      d.head.appendChild(d.createElement("script")).src = A;
      cal.loaded = true;
    }
    if (ar[0] === L) {
      const api = function () { p(api, arguments); };
      const namespace = ar[1];
      api.q = api.q || [];
      typeof namespace === "string"
        ? (cal.ns[namespace] = api) && p(api, ar)
        : p(cal, ar);
      return;
    }
    p(cal, ar);
  };
})(window, "https://app.cal.com/embed/embed.js", "init");

Cal("init", { origin: "https://app.cal.com" });

Cal("inline", {
  elementOrSelector: "#cal-embed",
  calLink: "wernerhl",

  config: {
    theme: "light"

});

Cal("ui", {
```
